urdu: آل پاکستان پرائیویٹ اسکول فیڈریشن نے انصر عباسی کے کس کام کو اسلام کے خلاف ثابت کرنے کے لئے استعمال کیا؟
english: Which work of Ansar Abbasi was used by All Pakistan Private Schools Federation to prove opposition to Islam?
roman_1: All Pakistan Private School Federation ne Ansar Abbasi ke kis kaam ko Islam ke khilaf sabit karne ke liye istemal kiya?
roman_2: All Pakistan Private School Federation nay Ansar Abbasi ka konsa kaam Islam ke khilaf sabit karne ke liye istamal kia?
roman_3: All Pakistan Private School Federation ne Ansar Abbasi ko kis kaam ke liye Islam ke khilaf sabit kiya?
